payload.title: digest-daily is the only slot where flow_path and trigger_prompt disagree, and the documented spawn rule picks the one that bypasses the daily dedup gate.
payload.found_how: Not a sweep — noticed while executing the spawn for this tick and verified before spawning, because the preflight surfaced both fields and they did not match.

findings.claim: Following spawn-fanout.md literally would spawn a flow with no day-level dedup gate.
evidence: docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/spawn-fanout.md:120 — 'prompt: "run <slot.flow_path>  slot=<slot.slot_id>"'. trigger_prompt is not mentioned anywhere in that file.

docs/data/cowork-schedule.json digest-daily: flow_path = docs/agents/digest-predict/flow/daily-predict.md, trigger_prompt = 'run docs/agents/digest-predict/flow/main.md  slot=digest-daily'. The two disagree.
docs/agents/digest-predict/flow/main.md Step pre-D holds the ONLY published:digest-daily:<UTC_DATE> claim (TTL 86400s), and routes onward to daily-predict.md at :142.

docs/agents/digest-predict/flow/daily-predict.md contains NO such gate — grep for published:digest-daily / dedup returns only :134, a git commit-mutex. Positive control: the same grep pattern matched the file's 144 lines, so the empty result is a real absence, not a broken query.
findings.consequence: A dispatcher that obeys spawn-fanout.md enters daily-predict.md directly, skipping Step pre-D. Cron re-fire, session restart, or dispatcher double-fire on the same UTC day then produces duplicate prediction claims — exactly what FEAT-PREDICTION-CLAIMS-DAILY-CADENCE built the gate to stop.

findings.detail: Checked all 23 slots: for every other slot the path inside trigger_prompt equals flow_path. digest-daily is the sole divergence, so this is a single-row data defect, not a schema-wide drift. Which field is stale is NOT asserted — resolving that is the architect's call, and it decides the fix direction (correct the schedule row, or teach spawn-fanout.md to prefer trigger_prompt when present).

Same defect class already recognised elsewhere in the fleet: FIX-FB-WEEKEND-DEDUP-GATE [REVIEW] — 'Add the MISSING period-keyed publish-once dedup gate to the FB weekend sub-flows'. Both are 'sub-flow entered directly, publish-once gate lives only in the parent'. Worth deciding once for both rather than twice.

digest-daily last_fired was 2026-07-19T17:34:44Z against cron '30 17 * * *', so the 2026-07-20T17:30Z fire did not happen — one missing day. Cause NOT determined (could be no dispatcher session alive at that tick, a lost election, or a suppressed match). Flagging only; a single gap is not yet a pattern.

payload.action_taken_this_tick: Spawned docs/agents/digest-predict/flow/main.md (the trigger_prompt target), NOT flow_path, so the dedup gate ran. Deviation from spawn-fanout.md is deliberate and recorded in the tick telemetry (docs/signals/cowork-team-20260721T173930Z.json).
payload.cowork_team_did_not: edit cowork-schedule.json slot definitions, edit spawn-fanout.md, mint or edit any board row, or mark any signal_queue row READ.
payload.requested_of_po: Route to architect to decide which field is authoritative, and fold in FIX-FB-WEEKEND-DEDUP-GATE if the answer generalises. Until then the dispatcher will keep preferring trigger_prompt when the two disagree, since that is the safe side of the fork.
